newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER AGAINST KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER AGAINST KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted weaker against most hard currencies at the close of interbank trade on Thursday, deelers said.

"We saw the dollar appreciate a little to start with, mainly due to tobacco receipts, but towards the end of the day there was massive intervention by the central Reserve Bank, which was buying from from the 11.2975 level up to 11.3150," one dealer said.

At Thursday's close, the local unit was trading at 11.3075/3175 against the U.S. dollar from 11.2960/3060 on Wednesday and was also quoted easier against sterling at 18.4400/4600 compared to 18.4015/4230.
It was at 6.5400/5600 from 6.5305/5325 versus the mark but firmed a little against South Africa's rand to 2.5200/5400 from 2.5270/5280.
